import json, hashlib, time
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
key=hashlib.sha256(str(repo.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
state=root/"state"
control=root/"control"

def read_json(p):
    try:
        v=json.loads(p.read_text())
        return v if isinstance(v,dict) else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}

def names(d):
    return sorted(p.stem for p in d.glob("*.json")) if d.is_dir() else []

liveness=read_json(state/"liveness.json")
browser=read_json(state/"browser_status.json")
outbox=names(state/"browser_outbox")
requests=names(control/"automation/do_again/requests")
receipts=set(names(control/"automation/do_again/receipts"))
pending=[r for r in requests if r not in receipts]

incidents=[]
for d in [state/"incidents", state/"runtime_incidents"]:
    if d.is_dir():
        for p in sorted(d.glob("*.json")):
            incidents.append({"path":str(p),"value":read_json(p)})

now=time.time()
terminal_at=float(liveness.get("ci_terminal_at") or 0)
age=(now-terminal_at) if terminal_at else None

print(json.dumps({
  "now":now,
  "terminal_age_seconds":age,
  "liveness":liveness,
  "browser_status":browser,
  "outbox_ids":outbox,
  "pending_requests":pending,
  "incidents":incidents[-20:],
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))

fp="Tran-Steven/do-again:37723478310:65f9a3e792c3cf3fa951df21fe9114a180d85d40:success"
if liveness.get("ci_terminal_fingerprint") != fp:
    raise SystemExit("terminal fingerprint changed or missing")
if any("selfdev-live-ci-handoff-proof-20261007-101" in x for x in outbox):
    raise SystemExit("duplicate CI wake entered outbox")
print("UNCERTAIN_CI_DELIVERY_AUDIT_OK")
